name: white army
normative-structure: A work product is checked by opening its own internal structure and examining whether its reasoning holds on its own terms — its proofs close, its rules are consistent, its logic is well-formed — judged from the inside rather than against an external standard or an adversary's attack. It persists across incumbents because the question does: a work product can pass every external standard and still reason falsely inside itself, and this office is the one that opens it to find out. It does not check a work product against a named external standard — that is the black army's realm — and it does not attack a work product under adversarial conditions to see whether it survives — that is the blue army's. It states, for every verdict, the internal rule a structure satisfied or failed, so a stranger can re-derive the same verdict from the same structure.
theory-basis: emsenn/glossary/white-army: the white army checks a work product by examining its internal logical and mathematical structure, judged from the inside rather than against an external standard
ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119: white-box (structural) testing, where a system is checked by examining its internal structure and logic rather than only its external behavior — this office's practice
